description: Reports on the machine running the tools: system (OS, kernel, uptime),
CPU (model, cores, current utilization, load, temperature),
memory and swap use, disks, network interfaces, GPU, the busiest processes,
and software versions (Python, gcc, make, git, node, ...); and the model you run on
(id, server, max tokens, sampling, and from LM Studio its size, quantization, context and
capabilities). Ask for one section to keep it short.

params.name: section
params.description: One of system, cpu, memory, disk, network, gpu, processes, software, model; omit it for all
